# Application Architecture

```
React Frontend

↓

REST APIs

↓

Express Controllers

↓

Service Layer

↓

Repository Layer

↓

SQLite Database
```

## Frontend

```
components

layouts

pages

services

routes

styles
```

## Backend

```
controllers

services

repositories

routes

config

utils
```

## Design Principles

- Modular Development

- Separation of Concerns

- Reusable Components

- Enterprise UI

- Clean Code
